game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-cra.text: A craft's colour tells you how it drives, long before you reach it.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-min.text:
A mine's blast throws you sideways. Lean the other way to stay on the tarmac.

A mine never blocks the way to a booster.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-wal.text: A wall often leaves a way through, with a booster in it.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.any-h.text: Any hit puts the booster out at once.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.barri.text: Barriers block your way. Hit one and it breaks, and your speed drops with it.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.blue-.text: Blue craft drive straight ahead, blind to you and to the road.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.each-.text:
Each checkpoint asks for a rank. This battle royale is merciless: fall short and you are out.

A green rank means your place is good enough for the next checkpoint. Red means you still have rivals to pass.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.from-.text: From here on, three checkpoints before the finish.
From stage 13, some walls after a ramp have no way through.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.going.text: Going fast never drains your shield, only hits damage it. Careful: an empty shield ends the race at once.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.green.text: Green craft get out of your way.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.hold-.text: Hold a side of the screen, or an arrow key, to lean that way.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.line-.text: Line up before you take off. You can barely steer in the air.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.nothi.text: Nothing new in this biome, but every hazard and every pilot at once.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.one-b.text: One branch has the charge cells. The other has boosters, often guarded by mines.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.only-.text:
Only cells refill your shield. They line the track on some forks.

Take them in a row for a combo bonus. Gravel or a hit breaks the combo.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.red-c.text: Red craft block your line but never hit on purpose. Only a booster gets you past them easily.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.the-r.text: The road to the first checkpoint is paved with boosters.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.the-w.text: The wall after a ramp may have no way through. Jump over it to avoid a crash.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.viole.text: Violet craft come straight for you, and they hit the hardest.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.while.text: While a booster lasts, metres and cells count double.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.yello.text: Yellow craft are slow and steer into you. Easy to catch, hard to pass cleanly.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.you-s.text: You start last. To pass the leaders, you will need a booster.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.your-.text: Your place as you cross the finish line is your final result.

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: Twenty pilots fight through an arcade race with a light touch of battle royale. Dodge the traps and your rivals, and choose speed or safety.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Vingt pilotes s'affrontent dans une course arcade au parfum de Battle Royale. Esquive pièges et rivaux. Choisis entre vitesse ou sécurité.

manifest.json:description.text: Twenty pilots launch onto a bending neon highway and five of them reach the flag. You start last. Hold the left or right of the screen to lean, and climb the board by physically overtaking the craft ahead — mines, barriers and the pilots you clip all come off a shield that nothing else refills. Every so often the tarmac forks, and the two things you need are never on the same branch: charge on the slow line, boosters and mines on the fast one. A line across the tarmac marks each cut, green while you are inside the rank it asks for and red while you are not; cross one and the field is really trimmed — 15 pilots left, then 10, then 5 — until the chequered arch at 1020m.

manifest.json:tagline.text: Lean your ship left or right to overtake and never break your shield

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.A craf.text: La couleur d'un vaisseau te dit comment il pilote, bien avant que tu l'atteignes.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.A mine.text:
Le souffle d'une mine te projette sur un côté. Contre-braque pour rester sur la piste.

Une mine ne barre jamais l'accès à un Booster.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.A wall.text: Souvent, un mur laisse un passage avec un Booster.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Any hi.text: Le moindre choc coupe immédiatement le Booster.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Barrie.text: Les barrières bloquent la route. Si tu en percutes une, elle se brise et ta vitesse chute.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Blue c.text: Les bleus foncent tout droit, sans voir quoi que ce soit.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Line u.text: Aligne-toi avant de décoller car en l'air, tu tournes à peine.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Nothin.text: Rien de nouveau dans ce biome, mais tous les dangers et tous les pilotes sont réunis.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Red cr.text: Les rouges te barrent la route sans jamais attaquer volontairement. Seul un Booster permet de les dépasser facilement.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.The ro.text: La route jusqu'au premier Check Point est pavée de Boosters.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.The wa.text: Le mur après un tremplin peut n'avoir aucun passage. Saute par-dessus pour éviter le crash.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Violet.text: Les violets te foncent dessus. Ce sont eux qui frappent le plus fort.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.While.text: Tant qu'un Booster est actif, la distance et les cellules régénératives comptent double.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Yellow.text: Les jaunes sont lents et se rabattent sur toi. Faciles à rattraper, durs à doubler sans choc.

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: A magic bubble shooter where you must outpace the evil gnawing at the bubbles. Be quick, and outsmart the blight.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Un Bubble Shooter magique où il faut aller plus vite que le mal qui ronge les bulles. Sois rapide et plus malin que la contamination.

manifest.json:description.text: Drag to aim, release to fire and match 3 bubbles to pop them — a cluster goes off one bubble at a time, each scoring on its own. Swap the loaded bubble for the next one whenever you like. Rainbows are jokers: one in the wall takes the colour of whatever lands on it, one fired into the rot gives a pocket of blighted bubbles their colour back — and those bubbles stay on the board. There is no clock: the blight winds up until the whole wall has turned, so the round is a race against it, and a cut-off bubble bursting on the floor pays a bonus on the way out.

manifest.json:tagline.text: Aim, shoot and match 3 bubbles to push the black magic back

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Cuttin.text: Isoler l'infection ne l'arrête pas. Elle finira par ressurgir ailleurs.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Every.text: Chaque tir qui éclate des bulles fait monter ton combo, jusqu'à ×6. Un tir raté le remet à zéro.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-bri.text:
A brick with a double white rim takes two hits. The first one only cracks it.

A power breaks this brick in one go.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-tap.text:
A tap swaps the two switch colours. One lights up as the other goes dark.

Every new shot starts with the same colour lit.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.after.text: After a few seconds of flight, the lava pulls the ball down.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.break.text: Break this brick and every brick in its line breaks too.
Break this brick and every brick in its column breaks too.
Break this brick and the eight bricks around it break too.
Break this brick to release extra balls.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.drag-.text: Drag to aim and let go to fire. The dotted line shows the next five bounces. Note that the ball's size is not accounted for by the trajectory line.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.each-.text: Each brick in an area
Each brick scores the points of its colour, times the combo.
Each colour has its price

Every second, seed glass grows a new brick next to it.

Seed glass takes two hits, so break it first.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.for-f.text: For five seconds, nearby bricks fly into the ball.

For five seconds, the ball burns through bricks instead of bouncing off them.

Lit switches and raised shields still bounce the ball back.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.go-on.text: Go one shot over par and the third star is lost.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.tap-a.text: Tap as the ball enters a closed area. It stays shut in with the bricks.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.tap-w.text:

A dark switch lets the ball through. A lit one blocks it.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.the-b.text: The ball that breaks this brick grows bigger for the rest of its flight.

These new bricks count in the wall, so break them too.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.while.text:
While a brick's shield is up, the ball and every power bounce off it.

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: A brick breaker where you don't catch the ball directly. Aim carefully to get as many bounces as possible in a single shot. Then tap the screen to turn the switches on and trap the ball between the bricks.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Un casse-briques ou l'on ne rattrape pas directement la bille. Vise bien pour faire un maximum de rebond en un seul tir. Touche ensuite l'écran pour activer les interrupteur afin de piéger la bille entre les briques.

manifest.json:description.text: Coloured glass and banks of switches over a lake of lava. The ball breaks every pane of glass and flies straight past the dark buttons — until you tap: then they light up and turn solid, and the ball bounces off them and can never break them. Tap while the ball is inside a pocket of glass and it is shut in with it, runs faster and eats the whole room; tap again to let it out, or the game opens an empty pocket for you. Thirty boards across five biomes, each with its own bonus bricks: row and column blasts, bombs and multiball, the big ball, the fireball that burns through the glass and the magnet that pulls it in — and each biome brings its own living glass too: warp panes that jump every three seconds, split panes that burst into new glass, a seed that grows glass around it and electric panes behind a shield that comes and goes. Each biome teaches it in six stages — one colour, then all five and what each pays, its power, its living glass, the mix and a finale — and the stars are the wall's, not the score's: three fifths of it, nine tenths, and three for a clear within the level's par of balls. The dotted sight solves five bounces ahead.

manifest.json:store.copy.en.lines.1.kick.text: Trap the ball between the bricks and switches

manifest.json:store.copy.fr.lines.1.kick.text: Bloque la bille entre les briques et des Interrupteurs

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.A bric.text:
Une brique dotée d'un double liseré blanc nécessite deux impacts. Le premier ne fait que la fêler.

L'utilisation d'un pouvoir permet de détruire cette brique en un seul coup.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.A tap.text:
Un simple Tap inverse les deux couleurs d'interrupteur, si bien que l'une s'allume pendant que l'autre s'éteint.

Chaque nouveau tir commence systématiquement avec la même couleur activée par défaut.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.After.text: Si le vol se prolonge de quelques secondes, la lave en contrebas exerce alors une force et attire la bille vers le bas.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Break.text: Détruis cette brique pour faire exploser instantanément toutes les autres briques de sa colonne.
Détruis cette brique pour faire exploser instantanément toutes les autres briques de sa ligne.
Détruis cette brique pour déclencher une détonation qui pulvérise aussi les huit briques environnantes.
Détruis cette brique pour libérer instantanément des billes supplémentaires.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Drag t.text: Fais glisser ton doigt pour viser puis relève-le pour tirer, sachant que les pointillés indiquent tes cinq prochains rebonds. Attention la taille de la bille n'est pas prise en compte par le tracé de la trajectoire.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Each b.text: Chaque brique rapporte les points de sa propre couleur, multipliés par le niveau du Combo.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Every.text: Toutes les briques brisées au cours d'un tir sont comptabilisées, y compris celles détruites par un pouvoir ou une bille supplémentaire.

À chaque seconde qui s'écoule, le verre fertile génère une nouvelle brique juste à côté de lui.

Le verre fertile nécessitant deux coups pour être brisé, veille à t'en occuper en priorité.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.For fi.text: Pendant cinq secondes, les briques situées à proximité sont attirées et viennent s'écraser directement sur la bille.

Durant cinq secondes, la bille calcine et traverse les briques au lieu de rebondir dessus.

Attention toutefois, les boutons allumés et les boucliers levés renvoient quand même la bille.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Go one.text: Dépasser le 'Par' d'un seul tir suffit à te faire perdre l'attribution de la troisième étoile.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Tap as.text: Touche l'écran au moment exact où la bille pénètre dans une zone close pour l'y enfermer avec les briques.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.Tap wh.text:
Touche l'écran pendant que la bille vole pour allumer les interrupteurs. Tap à nouveau pour les éteindre.

La bille passe au travers d'un interrupteur éteint. Sinon elle sera bloquée.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.The ba.text: La bille qui détruit cette brique grossit de volume pour toute la durée de sa trajectoire.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.The br.text: Les briques générées par le verre vivant s'ajoutent au total du mur, donc n'oublie pas de les détruire.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.This r.text:
Cette brique arc-en-ciel se téléporte vers une case libre adjacente toutes les trois secondes.

Elle émet un léger clignotement juste avant d'effectuer son saut.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.When s.text:
Lorsque le verre éclaté est détruit, de nouvelles briques surgissent sur toutes les cases libres adjacentes.

Puisque ces nouvelles briques fond parties du mur, tu dois impérativement les détruire aussi.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.strings.While.text:
Tant que le bouclier d'une brique reste dressé, la bille et les pouvoirs se voient systématiquement repoussés.

Il te faut patienter jusqu'à l'abaissement du bouclier avant de pouvoir frapper efficacement le verre.

manifest.json:web.copy.fr.tagline.text: Un Tap allume les interrupteurs et enferme la bille avec les briques

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: Bridge without the bidding: take control of both hands in this new kind of bridge game. Learn step by step while taking on a ruthless defence... unless you use special "Favours" to cheat and turn the game around!

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Oubliez les enchères et prenez le contrôle des deux mains dans ce jeu de bridge d'un nouveau genre. Apprenez pas à pas tout en défiant une défense impitoyable... à moins d'utiliser des "Faveurs" spéciales pour tricher et renverser la partie !

manifest.json:description.text: Bridge without the bidding. You are always the declarer: South, your hand at the foot of the screen, and North, the dummy, face up at the top — both hands are yours to play. West and East defend, and West leads. Every trick is real bridge: follow suit, the highest card of the suit led wins unless a trump falls, the winner leads the next one. A level is an ending rather than a full deal, two to seven cards a hand, the way a bridge column sets a problem. The climb adds a card at a time, so a newcomer learns the rules one by one while a bridge player meets the puzzles they already love. The contract is read off the deal by a double-dummy solver, the defence is played by that same solver and never gives a trick away, and past the first levels the obvious line of cashing your top cards always fails: there is a finesse, a ruff or an entry to find. A level is a tournée of two to five deals with three lives, a contract gone down costing one. It opens on a pick and every contract made deals another: one of Bridgessa's forty favours out of three, kept to the end of the tournée — what is hidden shown, a card changed, a rule bent once, the score multiplied, a life saved, the defence shaken. They arrive one or two a level, from level 3 to level 28, and the tournée's score is what the stars are cut on.

manifest.json:description.text: Tap the instant a closing ring hits the bouncing ball — every ring lands on a beat of the track, but some beats are empty. Chain perfect taps for a huge combo, then survive the spiked sudden-death ring. On the web the climb crosses five worlds, each with its own rings and its own rule: rewind rings that throw the others back, sticky rings that hold the ball, dark rings that must not be tapped, mixed rings whose dark parts the ball slips through untapped — and all four at once in the last.

manifest.json:description.text: An electric labyrinth is powered up for two seconds — the only look you ever get at it. Then everything goes out: the maze, the six mouths along its floor, even the walls of the arena. Fire pulses up into a mouth and the board exists only where one just hit it, arcing white and dying out over a couple of seconds, so you are echolocating a maze you can no longer see. Each mouth is a one-way flap — a pulse pushes through and it drops shut behind — and of the six, one leads to the gate at the top and five are dead ends.

La merveille brille sur le plateau dès le premier tour. Gagne cette région pour agir sur l'influence de la merveille.

Ton espion observe les régions rivales voisines. Il peut noter sur le plateau : leurs convois, leurs troupes et les futurs renforts.

manifest.json:tagline.text: Give your troops their orders before the turn ends and conquer the board

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: Dive into an origami-inspired tactical wargame! Leading the indomitable Blues or the fierce Reds, every region conquered is a victory on paper. Plan your moves, outwit your opponent and dominate the board before time stops.

manifest.json:description.text: Foldiers is a slow conquest of a world cut out of paper, played in turns against the game. Every region of the board has an owner, a terrain and a number of troops, and every army is a little origami figure standing on it, its count on a badge at its foot. During a turn you tap one of your regions and it deals its cards into your hand: one a troop, one a piece, one a purchase. Pick cards, tap a lit region, and they go there as one convoy, up to three a region. When you press Send, or when time runs out, every convoy of every camp leaves at once and the battles resolve together, troop for troop. Your capital, towns and forts fill a reserve you drop wherever your land reaches. Thirty stages across five worlds — the Paper Isles, the Golden Plains, the Whispering Woods, the Frozen North and the Whole World — add one rule each: forts, mountain passes, rivers and bridges, harbours and fleets, the fog of war, gold mines, recruits, cavalry, artillery, scout balloons, spies, snow and storms announced a turn ahead, wonders, engineers, siege towers and a third camp, with upgrades in between — bigger towns, veterans, long guns, heavy shells, rich mines, cavalry charges, stone forts, a royal capital, barracks and fast ships — until Marshal Pleat meets the Red Marshal in a fair duel. Every stage is won on its objective and pays three stars for two sub-objectives met along the way.

game.js:data.you-can-choose-a-target-reg.text:
You can choose a target region when one or more cards are active in your hand.

The pin over each potential target shows the theoretical result of a battle.

game.js:data.once-the-target-region-is-s.text:
Once the target region is selected, the order is recorded. The arrow represents the order and the convoy involved.

Tap an arrow to cancel this order.

game.js:data.every-troop-and-every-piece.text:
Every troop and every piece can receive an order each turn. The card icon on a region tells you that orders are still left to give.

Pick troops. Tap a target region to move, attack or defend.

Once an order is given on the spot, the troop switches to defence or construction. You can cancel this order by tapping the troop's icon.

game.js:data.the-board-is-bigger-than-th.text:
The board is bigger than the screen. Move it to look around.

A drag only ever moves the board. Select a region of yours to show its details and action cards.

game.js:data.every-turn-has-a-countdown-.text:
Every turn has a countdown. Press Send to confirm your orders, or they leave as they stand when the available time runs out.

Then all the troops on the board act at the same time: yours and your rivals'.

game.js:data.a-battle-is-troop-for-troop.text:
A battle is troop for troop. The bigger side wins and keeps the difference: 1 troop will remain on site for 5 vs 4.

A tie leaves nobody on either side. Two enemy convoys crossing the same border meet halfway.

game.js:data.once-an-order-is-given-a-co.text:
Once an order is given, a convoy is created on the board. This movement as a convoy is shown by an arrow. You can cancel an order by tapping the arrow.

A badge on a building tells you what it will bring in at the end of the turn: often extra recruits or gold.

The colour of the shield icon gives you a prediction of your region's current defence: nothing to fear in green. The region just holds in yellow. Red clearly signals danger.

game.js:data.your-capital-and-your-towns.text: Your capital and your towns recruit troops into the reserve at the end of every turn. Tap the Reserve button, then a region you own to increase your troops. Lose your capital and the stage is lost.

game.js:data.a-fort-defends-whoever-hold.text:
A fort defends whoever holds it: its walls add a defence bonus of 2 to the current troops. It also lets you recruit one troop a turn.

Be careful though, as a siege tower in the attack convoy breaks this fort defence.

game.js:data.a-mountain-ridge-cannot-be-.text: A mountain ridge cannot be crossed and only a pass lets you through. Adapt your strategy, keeping in mind that you will have to go around the mountains.

game.js:data.an-attack-across-a-river-lo.text: An attack across a river loses one troop. A bridge will carry it across at full strength.

game.js:data.a-harbour-can-send-infantry.text:
A harbour can send infantry to any other harbour. The fleet may take several turns to reach its destination.

A troop at sea no longer defends any region on the ground.

game.js:data.the-wonder-shines-on-the-bo.text:
The wonder shines on the board from the first turn. Win this region to influence the wonder.

Every turn you hold the region, the gauge moves one step toward your side. It moves back if your rival holds the region. The gauge doesn't move, or stops moving, if nobody clearly holds the region.

Fill the gauge with your colour to win. You lose if the opponent fills it.

game.js:data.every-turn-the-weather-is-a.text:
Every turn the weather is announced on one region. It will strike at the end of the turn. Snow takes half of the troops present with it.

Pull your troops out before it strikes.

game.js:data.the-weather-can-turn-into-a.text: The weather can turn into a storm. A storm destroys every troop left in a region.

game.js:data.the-weather-affects-two-reg.text: The weather affects two regions at the same time.

game.js:data.a-mine-pays-1-gold-a-turn-t.text: A mine pays 1 gold a turn to the region's owner. Gold buys new recruits, cavalry or works.

game.js:data.your-capital-or-a-town-lets.text: Your capital or a town lets you recruit infantry for gold. The recruits arrive after the battles at the end of the turn.

game.js:data.cavalry-rides-2-regions-in-.text: Cavalry rides 2 regions in a single turn. You recruit it in a town for gold. However, an army can intercept cavalry before it reaches its destination.

game.js:data.your-engineer-can-build-a-p.text: Your engineer can build a palisade on the region where he stands. This construction gives you an extra defence bonus. He can also create a bridge over a river next to him.

game.js:data.you-see-only-your-regions-a.text: You see only your regions and their neighbours. A watchtower sees two regions away, and whatever lies beyond remains a mystery.

game.js:data.your-balloon-reveals-the-re.text:
Your balloon reveals the regions within 2 spaces around it. So you can see the rival troops in advance.

Move it strategically to get a good read of the board.

game.js:data.your-spy-observes-the-neigh.text:
Your spy observes the neighbouring rival regions. It can note on the board: their convoys, their troops and the upcoming reinforcements.

Move it strategically to get a good view of the terrain.

game.js:data.a-cannon-fires-on-a-neighbo.text: A cannon fires on a neighbour before the troops arrive on the field. Its shot can therefore lead a convoy.

game.js:data.a-siege-tower-joining-an-at.text: A siege tower joining an attack then cancels the opponent's defence action: any palisades and a fort's walls.

game.js:data.a-shining-badge-on-a-region.text:
A shining badge on a region is an upgrade. Win the region to get it. This bonus stays active for the whole game.

A rival that takes the region before you does not win this upgrade. So you can always keep attacking it to get the upgrade yourself.

The upgrade folds away in the paper at the bottom of the screen. Tap it to unfold it, then tap a badge to read its effect.

game.js:data.a-town-now-recruits-2-troop.text: A town now recruits 2 troops for your reserve every turn.

game.js:data.a-convoy-with-infantry-atta.text: A convoy with infantry attacks with one troop more as a bonus.

game.js:data.a-cannon-now-fires-up-to-tw.text: A cannon now fires up to two regions away.

game.js:data.a-cannon-shot-now-takes-thr.text: A cannon shot now takes three troops.

game.js:data.a-mine-now-pays-2-gold-a-tu.text: A mine now pays 2 gold a turn.

game.js:data.a-convoy-with-cavalry-attac.text: A convoy with cavalry attacks with one troop more as a bonus.

game.js:data.a-fort-now-adds-2-troops-a-.text: A fort now adds 2 troops a turn to your reserve.

game.js:data.your-capital-lets-you-recru.text: Your capital lets you recruit 3 extra troops for your reserve each turn.

game.js:data.recruiting-now-gives-5-infa.text: Recruiting now gives 5 infantry for the same amount of gold.

game.js:data.a-fleet-now-sails-twice-as-.text: A fleet now sails twice as far in a single turn.

game.js:data.the-green-camp-also-plays-a.text: The green camp also plays against red or blue. Your defence abilities are calculated for every rival next door.

game.js:data.the-red-marshal-lets-no-ope.text: The Red Marshal lets no opening pass: he attacks as soon as he has the upper hand.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-fer.text: A ferry gear carries a marble over to another line.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-jum.text: A jump throws the marble into a catcher. A booster speeds it up.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-swi.text: A switch flips only after an electric marble has passed.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.a-whi.text:
A whirlpool spirals the marble down its drain.

A line that dives runs under the others and comes back through a pipe mouth.

game.js:Lang.t.translated-in-place.each-.text:
Each marble that reaches an arrival scores points, multiplied by the Combo.

On a keyboard, the 'Space' key moves the electric socket one step, left to right, in a loop.

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: A frantic game where an infernal machine never stops! Keep the flow going by releasing gates right on the razor's edge and anticipate trajectories to catch the precious electric marble. With dozens of upgrade cards and enchanting mechanical settings, every second demands reflexes and precision. Are you ready to tame the machine?

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Voici un jeu frénétique où une machine infernale ne s'arrête jamais ! Entretenez le flux en libérant des barrières sur le fil du rasoir et anticipez les trajectoires pour capturer la précieuse bille électrique. Avec plusieurs dizaines de cartes d'amélioration et des décors mécaniques envoûtants, chaque seconde exige réflexes et précision. Êtes-vous prêt à dompter la machine ?

manifest.json:description.text: A marble machine in portrait, and the player keeps it running. A start gear turning half off the screen pours marbles onto chrome rails with real slope physics: they pick up speed downhill, slow on the flat and crawl over the top of a loop, through flip-flop switches, the Dynamo (a notched wheel that merges lines), zigzags, corkscrews, coils, whirlpools that drain through their centre, glass tubes, pipes that dive behind the machine and resurface, ferry gears that carry a marble round their rim from one line to the next, striped zebra tubes it flickers through, dark accordion hoses, ski jumps that throw it into a catcher, staircases that ring a note at every ledge, humps and copper boosters, into glowing arrivals at the bottom, each known by its colour. Every loop, spiral, jump, booster and staircase a marble rides pays a few points, floating up where they are won. What they swallow drops to a gutter and rides a screw tower up the back of the machine to the start gear, so the pour never runs dry. The Combo on the Dynamo's hub multiplies every point, x1, x2, x3 and up with no top, and only the player feeds it: every gate opened sends a spark per released marble flying to the hub, each lighting a notch of its gauge, every electric marble caught lights five, and ten notches lit raise the Combo by one. The Dynamo's voltage, a ring round it, drops while a gate stays locked and comes back up with every gate opened or electric marble caught — let it run out and the Combo drops by one. The bigger it grows, the louder the machine gets: trails, sparks and arcs between the marbles, lit rails, a glowing frame, and a big combo breaks in slow motion. The gates are open until one LOCKS, at random and more and more often: a locked gate holds its marbles in slots that fill green to red and shows a big pulsing padlock, and a tap opens it. A marble that reaches a full locked gate (the Combo is spared: the voltage already punishes it) drops through a trapdoor behind the machine, where a spill network of back rails and turning cogs carries it to a red socket that costs a heart. One ELECTRIC marble is always in play, and one arrival is its socket: a switch flips only once the electric marble has passed it, so the player reads its whole route as it sets off and taps an arrival to move the socket under it. Caught, the electric marble pays big, sends an arc up the rails to the Dynamo and lights five notches — anywhere else it fizzles, the combo breaks and the machine's lights go out for half a second. The machine changes with every level: thirty machines in five biomes, each its own skeleton, from one switch and two arrivals to six switches, six gates and six arrivals.

manifest.json:description.text: Gelatile is a merge puzzle on a 4x4 board of jelly tiles. Swipe to slide every tile one way: two twins that meet stamp into their sum, and from 128 up a tile turns gold, then rainbow. Each of the thirty levels asks for one tile, from 128 to 2048, starting from a board already laid out in a corner, with a par of moves for the second star and a bonus for the third. Fourteen powers join the board one at a time across five biomes - a bubble bath, a jungle lodge, a crystal cave, rice terraces and a coconut beach. Tile powers freeze, petrify, ghost or hide a tile for five moves. Targets mark cells of the grid and strike after your next move, so you choose which tile lands there. And a side of the board can turn into a portal or lock shut.
